lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five visible vertical columns and four horizontal rows on the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form anchor points for the primary high-luminance blobs, creating a rectilinear grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges extending from behind the gills toward the posterior, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light above to shadow below.
